svg.title: An RC circuit that makes a lamp flash periodically
svg.desc: (a) Left, charging: the lamp has a very high resistance, so current from the source flows through R and charges C. Right, discharging: once the capacitor voltage reaches the lamp threshold, the lamp’s resistance drops and the capacitor discharges through it, lighting it. (b) The capacitor voltage rises along a charging curve to the bulb threshold, then repeatedly drops quickly as the lamp flashes and recharges to the threshold, giving a sawtooth.
